text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Tenant 'Thalia' - elevated 5xx rate (avg 12%) for inference endpoints in eu-west-1 over last 5m. Auto-threshold triggered. paging oncall.

oncall-ml: ack — I'm on it. seeing spike in infer-errors and tcp resets from edge-proxies -> worker pools. Correlating with packet drops in provider peering. pinging infra.

oncall-ml: metrics: 5xx rate per route: /v1/generate 13.4%, /v1/embed 4.1%. p50 latency +200ms. concurrent requests per shard spiked 2.2x. Logs show socket timeouts and 'kv-cache-miss' cascades.

infra-oncall: +1. I see flapping BFD sessions on eu-west-1 interconnects causing backend connection churn. Provider ticket open (INC-8421). We're preparing warm capacity in eu-west-2 and us-east-2. Recommendation: soft-redirect 25% traffic immediately, then 100% cutover if stable.

sre-lead: Good. Priorities: 1) isolate tenant to prevent global cascade 2) shift Thalia to dedicated warm pool (reserved) 3) keep customer updated. Ops runbook: use routing override then DNS TTL change if needed.

eng-runtime: To pre-warm KV cache and model weights on the target pool, run prefetch job. Preparing prefill job now.

eng-runtime: ```
# prefill command (run on control plane)
redwoodctl prefill --tenant thalia --model 'gpt-redwood-v1' --targets 'dedicated-thalia-us-east-2' --prefixes-file=/tmp/thalia_common_prompts.txt
```

oncall-ml: Started prefill. ETA ~3m for weights to load, ~5m for KV prefix cache to reach steady state. Curious: any golden prompts we should prime? pm-thalia can send.

pm-thalia: Sending top-50 prompt set now. Also: Thalia SRE asked for a heads-up and wants call if we switch DNS. I'll join oncall channel after this thread.

acct-thalia: Customer impact: degraded inference responses, users reporting timeouts. No data deletion risk. They're on a paid Dedicated plan — priority assistance requested. I'll coordinate comms.

infra-oncall: Initiating traffic-split via control-plane override (non-DNS) to start warm-run. Command:
```bash
redwoodctl traffic-split set --tenant thalia --from eu-west-1 --to dedicated-thalia-us-east-2 --percent 25 --mode gradual
```

infra-oncall: Executed. Monitor graphs for backend errors and cache-miss rate. Starting at 25% now.

oncall-ml: Observing error rate drop in eu-west-1 to 9% after split. us-east-2 shows healthy responses, p50 ~120ms. No spike in model load errors. Continuing.

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook check: make sure graceful-drain policy applied to old workers: `drain-mode: graceful` and `max-inflight=50` to avoid dropped requests.

sre-lead: Also enable automatic fallback policy on the routing layer: if destination error rate >10% for 2m then fail back to previous region. I want an oncall alert to escalate if that triggers.

infra-oncall: Fallback policy enabled. Now propose step to 60% after 6 minutes if stable.

oncall-ml: 6m update: prefill complete, cache hit ratio improved on target pool. Increasing split to 60%.

infra-oncall: ```bash
redwoodctl traffic-split set --tenant thalia --from eu-west-1 --to dedicated-thalia-us-east-2 --percent 60 --mode gradual
```

oncall-ml: 60% applied. eu-west-1 5xx rate trending down to 4.2%. us-east-2 stable. Customer latency for most requests now within SLA.

pm-thalia: Thalia SRE on call now. They want final cutover plan and to confirm DNS TTL change. They prefer a DNS cutover only after we reach 100% routing override for 15 minutes.

sre-lead: Agreed. We'll hold at 100% override for 15m then update DNS. Preparation: dns-eng please pre-stage CNAME and lower TTL to 30s for the record.

dns-eng: Pre-staging done. Current org DNS: thalia.api.redwood.ai -> eu-edge.euw1.proxy.redwood.net. New target: us-east-2-edge.proxy.redwood.net. TTL change request queued.

dns-eng: To reduce drift, we'll lower the current TTL to 30s now (propagation ~2m) then after 15m of stable override we'll swap the CNAME and raise TTL back to 300 if desired.

infra-oncall: We're ready to push to 100% via override. Once done we'll monitor for 5m then proceed with DNS steps.

oncall-ml: Rolling to 100% now.

infra-oncall: ```bash
redwoodctl traffic-split set --tenant thalia --from eu-west-1 --to dedicated-thalia-us-east-2 --percent 100 --mode immediate
```

oncall-ml: 100% in control plane. eu-west-1 backend errors reduced to baseline 0.2%. us-east-2 handling all traffic. p50 steady. No new errors.

pm-thalia: Notifying customer: "We are routing all Thalia traffic to warm reserve in us-east-2 to mitigate a regional network issue in eu-west-1. No data loss expected. We'll start DNS cutover shortly and will share exact timing." They asked for a brief conference at cutover. I'll schedule.

acct-thalia: Customer acknowledgement: :thumbsup: They appreciate the quick action and want postmortem once root cause confirmed.

dns-eng: TTL lowered to 30s on origin records. Propagation looks good. Waiting 15m window to complete.

oncall-ml: Monitoring during hold window. No regressions. Preparing for DNS swap.

dns-eng: Swapping CNAME now.

dns-eng: ```
# DNS change
thalia.api.redwood.ai. 30 IN CNAME us-east-2-edge.proxy.redwood.net.
```

oncall-ml: Observing gradual resolution to new endpoint for customer clients that respect TTL. Traffic via control-plane remains authoritative for now. Will keep both flags until TTL stabilizes.

sre-lead: After 10m of DNS propagation, raise TTL to 300 and remove routing override so normal routing takes effect. Confirm readiness.

infra-oncall: Ready to remove override in 5m after TTL ramp complete.

oncall-ml: 10m passed; DNS A records look consistent across global resolvers. Raising TTL to 300.

dns-eng: TTL set to 300. Propagation looks ok.

infra-oncall: Removing control-plane override; reverting to normal routing.

infra-oncall: ```bash
redwoodctl traffic-split clear --tenant thalia
```

oncall-ml: Revert done. Verification: global edge now directs to us-east-2. eu-west-1 is healthy but not receiving Thalia traffic. No errors observed. Closing mitigation.

pm-thalia: Customer on the conf call now, confirming their traffic is healthy. They requested timeline and immediate post-incident summary.

acct-thalia: Logged customer comms and ETA for postmortem next 48h.

sre-lead: Incident status: mitigation successful, customer routed to warm dedicated pool us-east-2 via control-plane override then DNS cutover. Next steps: RFO + provider network follow-up, fill incident template, and coordinate postmortem with Thalia team.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: Mitigation complete. moving to postmortem. Incident severity: Sev2 -> customer impact mitigated. Assigned: sre-lead for postmortem draft.

oncall-ml: handoff to day shift. handing to infra-oncall for provider follow-up and to sre-lead for postmortem. all clear here. :white_check_mark:

infra-oncall: Acknowledged handoff. I'll keep provider ticket updated and attach BFD session logs.

sre-lead: Thanks everyone. Good coordination. I'll own the postmortem and loop in PM/Acct for customer review.

ops-runbook-bot: Don't forget to archive the runbook changes: add a new line item for 'rapid routing override + DNS sequenced cutover' with checklist and times.

acct-thalia: Closing customer update: They requested a short executive summary once RFO ready.

oncall-ml: final note: no data persisted issues, model states intact, metrics normalized. Leaving monitoring alerts on for 24h.

sre-lead: thread closed for active mitigation. Reopen if issues reappear. :handshake:
